observations: Black game console wrapped in clear plastic film.
One black DualShock 4 controller is placed on top of the console.
The console has a vertical 'PS' logo on the right side.
The plastic wrap is torn and shows signs of handling.
No power cable, HDMI cable, or other accessories are visible.
The console appears to be a standard PS4 Slim model.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The console may not power on or may have internal hardware failure.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting up and displaying the PS4 home screen.

risks.risk: The controller may be non-functional or have stick drift.
risks.proof: A video showing the controller connecting to the console and navigating menus.

risks.risk: The console may be a counterfeit or non-genuine unit.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the serial number and a video of the console's system settings showing the model number.
risks.if_unproven: as a generic or counterfeit unit

risks.risk: Missing essential accessories (power cable, HDMI cable, etc.).
risks.proof: A photo showing all included accessories laid out.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and showing the PS4 home screen.
Video of the controller connecting and being used.
Photo of the console's system settings showing the model number and serial number.
Photo of all included accessories (power cable, HDMI cable, etc.).
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
